primarySourceRefresh.patchInspection: Go CL endpoints unavailable in web tooling; no claim to have read their diffs

decisionRationales.CVE-2026-39834: Accept specifically scoped process/CPU/network write-loop availability risk as routine under already-approved desktop policy. Positive actual file/module/alias/path binding exists; affected code remains visible and unfixed. No finding is declared harmless, fixed, unreachable, or prevented by SELinux.
decisionRationales.CVE-2026-39830: Do not grant routine entries from a generic process-DoS label: explicit cumulative leak survives Close. Retained evidence lacks connection/retry lifetime, sustainable memory bounds or containment for actual consumers, especially long-lived agents/proxies. Source/bounds proof or signed owning binary fix is needed.
decisionRationales.GO-2026-6612: No entry: bypasses configured connection flow-control budget; actual concurrent-stream, per-stream and connection counts plus process/host isolation needed to bound aggregate memory. Do not extrapolate SSH CPU-loop acceptance to host OOM protection.
